item.title: Google Open-Sources AX a Kubernetes Style Orchestrator for Autonomous AI Agents
item.description: Google has open-sourced AX, an orchestrator designed for managing autonomous AI agent workloads. AX operates on a runtime, Agent Substrate, treating agents as stateful actors. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Tracking When a PersistentVolumeClaim Was Last Used (Beta)
item.description: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes the PersistentVolumeClaimUnusedSinceTime feature gate to Beta (enabled by default). (1 source: kubernetesblog)
